summary.key_theme: Apple 透過與 Qualcomm 續簽全球專利授權協議鞏固供應鏈穩定性，並持續在印度市場擴張與產品策略轉型上展現成長潛力。

bullish.title: Qualcomm Announces Renewal of Global Patent License Agreement with Apple
bullish.reason: Apple 與 Qualcomm 續簽全球專利授權協議，確保了 iPhone 關鍵零組件供應的穩定性，消除了市場對潛在法律糾紛的擔憂。

bullish.title: Inside India newsletter: Apple set to take a bigger bite of the world’s second-largest smartphone market
bullish.reason: Apple 透過新 iPhone 發布積極搶佔印度市場份額，該地區作為全球第二大智慧型手機市場，是 Apple 未來營收成長的關鍵引擎。

bullish.title: Apple stock is giving new CEO John Ternus plenty to smile about
bullish.reason: 市場對新任執行長 John Ternus 的領導能力與產品策略持正面態度，股價表現反映了投資人對管理層交接後的信心。

bullish.title: Prediction: This Is What a $1,000 Investment in Apple Will Be Worth by 2030
bullish.reason: 分析師長期看好 Apple 的獲利能力與市場地位，認為其作為長期投資標的仍具備顯著成長空間。

bullish.title: Apple Price Prediction: Why Our Target Sits Above Wall Street’s
bullish.reason: 部分研究機構認為華爾街低估了 Apple 的潛力，並給予高於市場共識的目標價，顯示基本面仍有超預期空間。

bullish.title: Could John Ternus’ Product Strategy Reshape Apple’s (AAPL) Next Growth Phase?

bullish.title: Apple's rumored iPhone 20 could change the phone's look in a big way

bearish.title: A New Brand Of Inflation Slams This Smartphone Segment
